Main.dc.html.title: 1 · Overview: one flow, two front ends

f1.text: Finding 1 (fixed in 46f4a46, branch fix/inception-ux-quick-wins): the 'search again' option printed as __delta_probe__ (grounded.py:319). It now reads 'Search again, narrower'.

f2.text: Finding 2 (fixed in 46f4a46): SKILL.md suggested limit 10, below POOL_THIN_FLOOR 12 (gates.py:23), so every default run warned 'thin pool'. The skill now defaults to 25.

f3.text: Finding 3: the wizard probes from year 2000 in keyword mode (engine.py:268), then asks the date window at Stage 3. Anchors can fall outside the review window. Scope (years, language, search mode) moves to step 1.

f4.text: Finding 4: an unanchored concept exits the whole wizard at Stage 4b, after ~15 answers (grounded.py:448). One probe budget of 3 covers all concepts and synonyms. Boards 2 and 5 check anchors inline, show the budget, and save a draft.

f5.text: Finding 5: grounded default concepts are unbounded (grounded.py:400) and every accepted concept gets its own synonym prompt. Board 2 shows a checklist with the top 8 preselected.

f6.text: Finding 6 (default marker fixed in 46f4a46): choice() now marks the default. Still open: the refraction grid is ~180 columns wide (display.py:22); board 9 replaces it with paradigm cards.

f7.text: Finding 7 (fixed in 46f4a46): a narrower search that found no direction was silent (grounded.py:342). It now prints the outcome either way.

f8.text: Finding 8: the pre-emit panel shows counts only (wizard.py:338) and there is no way back. Board 4 shows the content with Edit links and lists every file that will be written.

f9.text: Finding 9: pool health is reported as purity / QEI jargon, and the QEI reading inverts on coherent pools. Plain badges ('Focus: mixed subfields') with the raw value in the detail line.

f10.text: Finding 10: session ids differ between front ends (12-hex uuid in the wizard, rec_<hex> from MCP). Worth one format so the GENESIS lineage reads the same.
